title: Keep an entity’s evidence detail
responsibility: Reduces revision and record details to what belongs to one entity while preserving its evidence sides.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.evidence
inputs.description: The entity-scoped evidence whose coverage determines which scenario states to retain.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.entityId
inputs.description: The exact unit identity to retain in registry details, reasons, failures, measurements, budgets and change summaries.

outputs.name: recordedProjection
outputs.description: A new evidence object with each detailed side reduced to the entity and its covered scenario states. Keeps all tests, existing captures and coverage, and the corresponding judging record; removes unrelated units, graph edges, changed-file lists and uncertainty lists. A side without detail is retained unchanged. The supplied evidence is not mutated.
